## `/ping`

Check that Keystone is awake.

No subcommands; the root has its own options.

## `/about`

Show what Keystone is and how this server is configured.

No subcommands; the root has its own options.

## `/help`

Browse every Keystone command, search the catalog and check data retention.

| Subcommand | Description | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/help browse` | List the command roots, grouped by module. | `module` |
| `/help commands` | Show every root and its subcommands. | `module` |
| `/help search` | Find a command by name, description or module. | `query` |
| `/help privacy` | Explain what Keystone stores and what it does not. | — |
| `/help changelog` | Show the current version and the latest pass. | — |

## `/setup`

Check database, migrations, cache and module readiness.

No subcommands; the root has its own options.

## `/config`

Inspect and change any module's per-guild settings through the bot's own schema.

| Subcommand | Description | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/config list` | List every module and whether it is enabled here. | — |
| `/config get` | Show one module's effective settings, or one dotted key. | `module`, `key` |
| `/config set` | Validate and write one dotted key; the module's Zod schema is the gate. | `module`, `key`, `value` |
| `/config export` | Export every module's effective settings as JSON. | — |

## `/export`

Export, inspect or restore this server's data without leaving Discord.

| Subcommand | Description | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/export guild` | Download the full server bundle with settings, cases and history. | — |
| `/export user` | Download one member's cases, tickets, XP and ledger rows. | `user` |
| `/export import` | Preview or restore a keystone.export bundle attachment. | `bundle`, `mode`, `dry_run` |

| `/export drift` | Compare stored channel and role ids with the live server. | — |
| `/export rollback` | Restore the pre-import backup of an applied import. | `import_id` |

## `/music`

Save tracks in a durable queue and inspect playback readiness.

| Subcommand | Description | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/music play` | Ask the playback backend to play; refuses when none is installed. | `query` |
| `/music queue` | Show the saved queue and whether audio is actually playing. | — |
| `/music add` | Save a track for later; this never plays audio. | `query`, `title` |
| `/music remove` | Remove one saved track by position. | `position` |
| `/music clear` | Clear every saved track. Nothing is left playing. | — |
| `/music skip` | Skip the current track; refuses when there is no player. | — |
| `/music stop` | Stop playback; refuses when there is no player. | — |
| `/music status` | Show module state, queue count and the exact playback blocker. | — |

## How to change this page

1. Edit the command definition or manifest.
2. Run `pnpm commands:catalog`.
3. Run `pnpm check`.
